settings_logo_must_be_image: The file must be an image
settings_app_description: Preferences for this device only; they don't affect anyone else.
settings_screen_language_hint: The screen language on this device. Reports use the HOA's language.
settings_dialog_description: General details shown throughout the app.
settings_residential_name_empty_hint: If you leave it empty, it will show as "{label}".
settings_language_hint: The HOA's default language: reports, generated text, and the screen language for anyone who hasn't picked their own.
settings_currency_change_description: Existing records keep their currency, including existing periods and their fees. Review the suggested common area rates: they'll be used as they are in {currency}.
settings_logo_hint: Shown on reports. A PNG with a transparent background is recommended, up to 2 MB.
settings_remove_logo_description: Reports will only show the HOA name. To use the logo again, you'll have to upload it again.

settings_setup_description: Before you start, choose the HOA's name, language and currency.
settings_setup_description_single_langua: Before you start, choose the HOA's name and currency.
settings_residential_name_hint: Shown in the menu and on reports.
settings_setup_currency_hint: You can change it later in "Settings"; existing records keep their currency.
settings_welcome_ability_residential: Add the houses and their residents.
settings_welcome_ability_presidency: Open fee periods and book the common areas.
settings_welcome_ability_hoa_board: Add members and share their access link with them.
settings_welcome_ability_treasury: Record income, expenses and paid fees, and their categories.
settings_welcome_ability_payment_request: Mark the ones from "Maintenance" and "Security" as paid or rejected.
settings_welcome_ability_maintenance: Record jobs and purchases. Each one reaches "Treasury" as a payment request.
settings_welcome_ability_security: Record security expenses. Each one reaches "Treasury" as a payment request.
settings_welcome_ability_logs: Review every change in the app: what was done, by whom and when.
settings_welcome_intro_description: Here's a short introduction to what you can do in the app.
settings_welcome_abilities_description: Based on your role, these are the sections where you can add and edit.
settings_welcome_overview_description: The whole HOA board works with the same information.
settings_welcome_view_all_body: Every section is open to you. The buttons to add or edit only show up where you have permission.
settings_welcome_home_body: The period summary, pending fees and payment requests.
settings_welcome_report_body: In "Reports", in the sidebar, download a PDF of the income, expenses and pending fees for the dates you choose.
settings_welcome_logged_body: Everything that's created, edited or deleted is logged in the app, along with who did it and when.
settings_welcome_revisit_body: Tap your name in the sidebar and choose "View introduction".
settings_welcome_first_step_description: Only the people you add to the HOA board can sign in.
settings_welcome_invite_body: Add each member in "HOA board" and send them the access link it creates, by WhatsApp or however you prefer. When they open it, they'll create their password to sign in.
settings_welcome_settings_body: Set the HOA's name and logo; they're used in the menu and on reports.
